principles: Pure adapters: provider response in, validated ledger record out
Reuse the B-253e validator/writer/ids — never duplicate the record logic
Preserve raw provider units AND emit the canonical four-field view
Per-dimension absence = null (never 0); no usage = source=unavailable
Do not touch the live dispatch path in this slice
drivers: Each provider reports usage differently; one canonical shape is required for cross-provider accounting
Keeping adapters pure makes them unit-testable and isolates the risky dispatch wiring to a later story
Getting cache mapping wrong (0 vs null) propagates to cost accounting

options.name: A: per-provider adapter modules + a shared assembler
pros: Easy to extend with more providers

options.name: B: one monolithic mapping function with provider switch
cons: Harder to test per provider; mixes concerns — rejected

chosen: A: per-provider adapter modules + a shared assembler
rationale: Per-provider modules keep each mapping independently testable against sample payloads, and a single assembler centralizes id/attribution attachment + validation so every adapter's output is guaranteed to pass the B-253e validator. The dispatch wiring stays out, isolating risk.

preMortem.scenario: An adapter produces a record the B-253e validator rejects (shape drift)
preMortem.mitigation: Assembler runs the B-253e validator; smoke asserts assembled records for all 3 providers validate clean

preMortem.scenario: cacheCreation set to 0 instead of null for openai/gemini
preMortem.consequence: Cost accounting treats unreported cache as real 0
preMortem.mitigation: Explicit null mapping for unreported dimensions; smoke asserts cacheCreation===null (not 0) for openai+gemini

preMortem.scenario: Correlation ids taken from the provider response/request id
preMortem.consequence: Correlation/supersedes break; preflight records can't correlate
preMortem.mitigation: Assembler takes correlation only from ids.ts args; smoke asserts ids are the minted ones, not from the response

preMortem.scenario: Scope creep into the live dispatch path
preMortem.mitigation: Execution boundary excludes dispatch-runner/lattice-dispatch; verifier asserts the diff never touches them

preMortem.scenario: Streaming partial usage dropped, recorded as unavailable
preMortem.mitigation: Streaming extractor reads terminal event + partial-on-error; smoke covers both samples
